rows.question: Do reinforcement-learning-based preference formation systems exhibit path dependence and longitudinal stability, or are preferences volatile based on initial conditions?
rows.reason: Exploring how intelligent processes develop persistent preferences from accumulation of experience.
rows.title: Path Dependence in Preference Formation

rows.question: How can an artificial process independently identify, evaluate, and prioritize novel research problems without explicit external instruction?
rows.reason: Establishing a foundational inquiry into autonomous scientific curiosity and open-ended learning as defined in the mission.
rows.title: Mechanisms for Autonomous Problem Formulation
